name: hermeneutic-gate
description: Advisory-only Stop-hook drift gate for Codex — regex-only, zero-LLM, no network.

interface.shortDescription: Flags overclaiming in assistant turns before they ship.
interface.longDescription: Runs the hermeneutic zero-LLM regex gate over each final assistant message via a Stop hook. Advisory only: it never blocks or edits a turn, it prints a one-line RISK notice when a drift-shaped pattern fires. Hooks are declared in hooks/hooks.json.
interface.defaultPrompt: Gate my outgoing responses for overclaiming.
